name: Transformer through-fault accumulation monitor
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Records the defined exposure of the transformer to external fault-current events.
description: Records the defined exposure of the transformer to external fault-current events. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Through-fault current events” at the input and “Accumulated fault-duty information” at the output. Duty estimation is not a direct remaining-life measurement.
